name: relay-ai-inbox
description: Relay — AI-powered personal assistant email management dashboard (Assistant command center + minimal Client view).

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
